name: get-timeline-threads-from-person-id
query: query GetTimelineThreadsFromPersonId($personId: UUID!, $page: Int!, $pageSize: Int!) { getTimelineThreadsFromPersonId(personId: $personId, page: $page, pageSize: $pageSize) { ...TimelineThreadsWithTotalFragment } } fragment TimelineThreadsWithTotalFragment on TimelineThreadsWithTotal { totalNumberOfThreads relatedPersonIds timelineThreads { ...TimelineThreadFragment } } fragment TimelineThreadFragment on TimelineThread { id read visibility firstParticipant { ...ParticipantFragment } lastTwoParticipants { ...ParticipantFragment } lastMessageReceivedAt lastMessageBody subject numberOfMessagesInThread participantCount lastMessageIsDraft } fragment ParticipantFragment on TimelineThreadParticipant { personId workspaceMemberId firstName lastName displayName avatarUrl handle }
